question: Find students whose total marks across all assessments are greater than the average total marks per student.
generated_sql:
SELECT s.student_id, s.name, s.roll_number
FROM students s
JOIN (
    SELECT e.student_id, SUM(m.marks_obtained) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.assessment_type) AS avg_total_marks
    FROM enrollments e
    JOIN marks m ON e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id
    GROUP BY e.student_id
) t ON s.student_id = t.student_id
WHERE SUM(t.avg_total_marks) / COUNT(t.avg_total_marks) > (
    SELECT AVG(SUM(m.marks_obtained) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.assessment_type))
    FROM enrollments e
    JOIN marks m ON e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id
)
